name: add_to_shopping_list
description: Add one or more items to the guest's on-screen shopping list — bottles, mixers, garnishes, or tools they're missing for a drink. Duplicates are ignored automatically. Call it when the guest doesn't have something a recipe needs, or when they ask you to note something down. Does not return anything.

items.description: Items to add, each a short plain name, e.g. ["Lime", "Simple syrup", "Cocktail shaker"].
